create_azure_content_safety_hook: create an Azure Content-Safety hook by instantiating _PROXY_AzureContentSafety with endpoint, api_key, and optional thresholds
test_violation_content: test if text content violates Azure Content-Safety policies for hate, self_harm, sexual, and violence categories
configure_safety_thresholds: configure severity thresholds for Azure Content-Safety text categories with custom or default values
pre_call_hook_messages: run pre-call hook that scans input message content against Azure Content-Safety before model completion
post_call_hook_response: run post-call success hook that scans model response content against Azure Content-Safety after completion
